honest_limits: The GitHub arm of the G4 check returned HTTP 403 for every attempt in this round - rate-limited or blocked from this container. Under 0008's frozen clause that means white space was NOT established first-hand for any candidate whose check included it, and those candidates cannot SELECT. That is the clause working: an incomplete check is not evidence of white space.

arXiv queries all returned HTTP 200 with real response bodies, including a 788-byte empty result set, which is what distinguishes a genuine zero from the 301-with-0-bytes failure the archived trial nearly published as white space.
No patent search was run, which round 4 established as a demonstrated blind spot.

Several candidates were screened out on paper before any G4 query, because an earlier clause already failed. Their G4_queries lists are empty and they are recorded as unchecked rather than as white space.
method: Enumerate transform label factories across the four NON-LOSS withholding modes C1 names as its falsifier, screen each against G1..G5 and L1..L4 with default posture REJECT, and check white space first-hand for those surviving the paper screen.
